children: TORONTO, Sept. 9, 2026 /CNW/ -- Element Fleet Management Corp. (

) ("Element" or the "Company), today announced that Laura Dottori-Attanasio, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Scotiabank Financials Summit in Toronto on September 10, 2026 at 11:10 a.m. ET.
The fireside chat will be broadcast live via webcast
. A recording will be available following the event on Element's website.

) is the largest publicly traded pure play automotive fleet manager in the world and a global leader in intelligent fleet and mobility solutions. Guided by our Purpose to Move the world through intelligent mobility, we help clients manage the vehicles, data, technology, and decisions that keep their businesses moving. Fleet is our foundation, and intelligent mobility is how we lead. By combining deep fleet expertise with connected technologies, data driven intelligence, and strategic partnerships, Element helps clients lower total cost of ownership, improve uptime and driver experience, and build more resilient operations. Element manages over 1.5 million vehicles globally and leverages this scale and data to help clients optimize performance, identifying over $1.7 billion in cost savings opportunities across our clients' fleets in the past year.
